as=player, desktop and mobile (judged for the variable-count void banish cost prompt; not in the D21 sample). With five staged void cards the banish prompt asks for 1 to 5 void cards with exactly the void as candidates, the played card excluded, and a selection counter; on mobile the gallery scrolls and Submit stays uncovered once cards are selected. Cancel restores the void and energy; reload mid-prompt restores the same prompt id and candidates with nothing committed. Banishing three sets X=3: the three chosen cards are banished, the other two stay in the void, 2● is paid, the private arrangement shows the top 3 deck cards with Hand 2/2 and Bottom 1/1, and the two chosen cards reach the hand while the third goes to the bottom. The battle log lists each banish, the play, the look, both cards put into the hand (not draws) and the bottom placement. __caps empty.

as=enemy, desktop and mobile: with three void cards staged the AI plays Fractured Veil, banishes one void card (X=1) into its public Banished zone, looks at its top card and puts it into its hand; the log reads it in plain language without naming the hidden card, the enemy hand stays face down, and __caps is empty. The debug panel button overlaps the log close button on mobile (debug-only overlay, pre-existing).
